subject.title: [Bug]: Managed node install can retain invalid Gateway connection settings

question: Should maintainers sponsor and land the linked managed-node credential and TLS-retargeting fix now?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the issue has a protected maintainer label and the repair changes credential persistence, systemd secret serialization, uninstall scrubbing, and TLS pinning behavior.

options.title: Land linked fix after review
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103093 once its review blocker is resolved and the focused credential/TLS regressions are green.

options.title: Split the security-sensitive parts
options.body: Ask for separate password/env-file and TLS-retargeting changes if maintainers want smaller security-boundary review units.

options.title: Defer protected work
options.body: Keep the issue assigned without queueing a new automated fix until maintainers choose a release window.

recommendation.title: Land linked fix after review
recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103093 once its review blocker is resolved and the focused credential/TLS regressions are green.
